meta.name: Operational Editorial
meta.description: A typographic backend-engineering portfolio organized as a scroll-driven editorial record.

color.strategy: Warm paper and near-black fields with one functional red signal. No gradients or decorative semantic colors.

typography.strategy: Oversized tight sans statements, limited editorial italic interruption, mono only for evidence and indices.

layout.desktop: Sticky hero, normal-flow manifesto, pinned horizontal project document, ticker interval, two-column stack, full-height contact.
layout.mobile: Fitted sticky hero followed by a complete vertical reading order.
layout.shape: Square fields and one-pixel rules; no card radius system.

visual_effects.hero: Three lines separate laterally under scrubbed vertical scroll.
visual_effects.projects: A pinned five-screen horizontal track with content reveals inside the same timeline.
visual_effects.practice: Two oversized discipline rows counter-scroll across a red field.
visual_effects.reduced_motion: All scripted motion is removed while semantic content remains in normal flow.
visual_effects.performance: Transform and opacity animation only; no WebGL, canvas, video, filters, or particle loop.
